actual_scope: Kappa-blocker KB5j (authorized explicit open request): SETTLE LEMMA BPP's WITHOUT-LOSS QUESTION of open problem F-star (cert(M) >= floor(2v/3) for exact 3-total rational decoders): may one assume, without loss at tau >= 1, that an attaining L8 witness satisfies Lemma BPP conditions (i)+(ii), i.e. is box(M) = cert(M) for every exact 3-total decoder with tau(t) >= 1? Either prove box-completeness (projection/repair lemma), construct the minimal tau >= 1 counterexample with both sides exact, or isolate the precise parity obstruction to repair with a minimal demo.

author: Aaron Wang (with help from opencode)
bottleneck_link: F-star (cert(M) >= floor(2v/3)) is the named route to closing every open T = 3 window at once (research/root-unit-decoder-lemmas section 7). PR 2963 named Lemma BPP's without-loss question as the exact blocker of the box-completeness route. This package settles it: box-completeness FAILS at tau >= 1 (minimal counterexample v = 3, cert = 3 > box = 2), so the completeness link of the PR 2914 chain is dead; the box-floor link and cost >= cert survive, and the surviving narrowed question (shareable class c_j = gamma) is stated exactly.
evidence: VERDICT: Lemma BPP's without-loss question is answered NO at tau >= 1. PROVEN: box = cert = 2 at v = 2 for tau >= 1 (written proof + exhaustive machine check of all 2842 scope-consistent patterns), so v = 3 is minimal. PROVEN: minimal tau >= 1 counterexample at v = 3: P = [[-1,-3,0],[1,-1,-2],[3,3,3]], Q = [[1,-3,2],[3,-1,-2],[3,-1,2]], M = diag(8,8,12), tau = (2,2,2): cert = 3 (replayed attaining witness a = b = [1,2,4], order [2,1,0]; independent enumeration) > 2 = box (PROVEN upper bound: Lemma RT triangular rank + shareable totals r_box = 2; explicit box witness). PROVEN: the obstruction's exact form - in the box only totals with c_j = gamma (shareable) can enter K, and when every forward pair is a zero arc K[S,S] is unit triangular, so |S| <= r_box; the third total (c_2 = 1 > gamma = 0) is only usable via non-tied shared bits, i.e. BPP condition (i) fails on every attaining witness. CHECKED: PR 2963's 19 distinct escapes are all cosmetic (E1); 360 realizable tau >= 1 instances show 1788 strict projection drops (E2 1768) with 0 box violations, so projection is not without loss either. CHECKED: 3023 v = 3 combinatorial configs, 27 gap candidates, 3 realized as counterexamples, 3 unrealizable (column-attainment), 21 not realized in cap (alphabets up to {+-1..+-7}/{+-2..+-6,0}).
existing_restriction_being_changed: Audits/settles PR 2914 open question 1 + PR 2936 open question 1 as narrowed by PR 2963 (box-completeness for tau >= 1). The PR 2914 route (b) required cert = box-max at tau >= 1 plus a box floor; this package refutes the equality.
falsification_test: Any counterexample claim is falsified by replaying the stored witnesses and recomputing both rungs from the definition: verify.py re-enumerates cert and box INDEPENDENTLY of the vendored engine (section-7 enumeration) and asserts 3 and 2; the box upper bound is a written rank proof, not a scan; corrupted-witness rejection and the tie/scope identities are asserted on every instance; the v = 2 completeness claim is falsifiable by any of the 2842 enumerated patterns failing.
method: Smallest instance first. (1) Classify the escape mechanism of PR 2963's 21 escaping witnesses exactly (BPP projection, conditions (i)/(ii), per-escape-line bits). (2) Exhaustive combinatorial reduction: cert and box of a decoder depend only on (pi, sg, zero-digraph Z, a0, b0); cert is over-approximated by the full-label value cert_max(Z) (monotone in label freedom), so cert_max(Z) <= box proves completeness on that datum and cert_max(Z) > box is a candidate. v = 2 all scope-consistent patterns; v = 3 all patterns up to line/total relabeling. (3) Realize candidates by exact 3-total integer decoders via the odd/even valuation recipe (m_j = 0 normalization; odd on anchor bits), per-q-row exhaustive search with seeded P restarts, alphabets {+-1,+-3}/{+-2,0} then {+-1..+-7}/{+-2..+-6,0}. (4) Certify every value by replayed witnesses, exact enumeration, an independent section-7 enumeration, and written rank bounds (Lemma RT); int-only arithmetic.
nearest_overlapping_prs: PR 2914 (sub-anchor box, Lemmas SB/LB), PR 2936 (Lemma BPP, tau >= 1 necessary, v = 7..11 census), PR 2963 (tied_min v = 11 exact, box weak cell closed, BPP strictness at tau = 0). None settles the without-loss question; this package does, negatively, with the minimal counterexample.

open_questions.question: Are the 21 remaining v = 3 combinatorial gap patterns (a0, b0, Z) realizable by exact 3-total decoders?
open_questions.why_it_matters: All 21 lie in the shareable class (r_box = 3), so a realization refutes box-completeness there too, while a proof of unrealizability would prove box-completeness at v = 3 in the shareable class - the class holding all prior evidence.

open_questions.blocked_by: 8^4 label enumeration per configuration times the zero-pattern lattice needs a DP or symmetry reduction before it is tractable.
open_questions.first_step: Extend the job-B combinatorial enumeration to v = 4 with a cert-side subset DP over the same (a0,b0,Z) lattice; then realize any gap datum as in job D.
open_questions.question: Box-completeness in the shareable class (every total has c_j = gamma) at v >= 4: is cert = box there?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is the exact surviving form of the without-loss question once Lemma RT's obstruction is excluded; every previous box = cert datapoint sits in this class.
